# Syed Co.

> Syed Co. is the personal site of Taimoor Syed, an investor, consultant and entrepreneur based in Vancouver, BC. He helps Canadian organizations with sales and marketing: SEO and AI search visibility, websites, brand, campaigns, paid ads, email, go-to-market strategy, audits, fractional leadership and sales process.

## About Taimoor Syed

- 10+ years in sales and marketing: running campaigns, door knocking, cold calling, go-to-market strategy, CPG packaging, and most recently building with AI
- Has worked with 50+ Canadian organizations across agriculture, CPG, restaurants, healthcare, government, associations, software and service-based businesses
- Works with scaling organizations across Canada

## Services

### Search & AI Visibility

- [SEO, AEO and GEO (AI search visibility)](https://syedco.com/services/seo-aeo-geo-ai-search-visibility/): SEO, AEO and GEO for Canadian organizations: get found in Google and in AI answers from ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity, with a clear plan and honest expectations.
- [Content marketing and thought leadership](https://syedco.com/services/content-marketing/): Content marketing and thought leadership for Canadian organizations: strategy, articles, guides and case studies that build trust, support SEO and bring in leads.

### Brand & Web

- [Website design](https://syedco.com/services/website-design/): Custom website design and development for Canadian organizations, planned around what visitors need to do and what your business needs them to do.
- [Brand strategy](https://syedco.com/services/brand-strategy/): Brand strategy and positioning for Canadian organizations: who you’re for, what makes you different and how to say it so your market remembers.

### Campaigns & Content

- [Marketing campaign strategy](https://syedco.com/services/campaign-strategy/): Marketing campaign strategy and planning for Canadian organizations: awareness, launch, growth, event and rebrand campaigns built around one clear objective.
- [Paid advertising (Google, Meta and LinkedIn)](https://syedco.com/services/paid-advertising/): Paid advertising for Canadian organizations: Google, Meta and LinkedIn campaigns, landing pages and tracking built around leads and sales, not clicks.
- [Social media marketing](https://syedco.com/services/social-media-marketing/): Social media marketing for Canadian organizations: strategy, content and management on LinkedIn, Instagram and more, tied to business goals, not likes.
- [Email marketing and automation](https://syedco.com/services/email-marketing/): Email marketing and automation for Canadian organizations: strategy, newsletters and automated sequences built to nurture leads, with CASL-aware practices.
- [Video and photo production](https://syedco.com/services/video-and-photo-production/): Brand video, product photography, event coverage and social content for Canadian organizations, planned around a goal so every shot has a purpose.

### Strategy & Leadership

- [Go-to-market strategy](https://syedco.com/services/go-to-market-strategy/): Go-to-market strategy for new products, services and markets in Canada: customers, positioning, channels and a three-phase launch plan.
- [Marketing audit](https://syedco.com/services/marketing-audit/): A marketing audit for Canadian organizations: a clear review of your goals, channels, website and spend, with a prioritized 90-day action plan.
- [Fractional marketing leadership](https://syedco.com/services/fractional-marketing-leadership/): Fractional marketing leadership for Canadian organizations: senior strategy, budget and team direction without a full-time executive hire.

### Sales & Growth Systems

- [Sales process setup](https://syedco.com/services/sales-process-setup/): Sales process setup and coaching for Canadian organizations: map your funnel, find where deals leak and build a repeatable process your team can follow.
- [Outbound lead generation](https://syedco.com/services/outbound-lead-generation/): Outbound lead generation for Canadian B2B organizations: target lists, email, LinkedIn and phone outreach plans that start conversations with the right buyers.
- [AI marketing and sales automation](https://syedco.com/services/ai-marketing-and-sales-automation/): AI marketing and sales automation for Canadian organizations: practical workflows for content, lead follow-up and reporting, with human review and clear guardrails.

## Insights

- [Insights index](https://syedco.com/insights/): practical writing on sales, marketing and growth
- [Why your marketing isn’t working (and how to find the real problem)](https://syedco.com/insights/why-your-marketing-isnt-working/): It’s rarely the budget or the platform. Three things to check first when your marketing isn’t delivering, and a simple plan to fix it.
- [Why sales stalled, and where to look first](https://syedco.com/insights/why-sales-stalled/): Before you hire, discount or panic, spend 30 minutes finding where deals are actually falling off. A simple way to diagnose a sales slump.
- [Agency, freelancer, in-house or fractional: how to choose](https://syedco.com/insights/agency-freelancer-in-house-or-fractional/): There’s no best option for marketing or sales help, only the right one for your problem, budget and time. How to choose, what to ask and what to avoid.
- [How to launch a product in Canada](https://syedco.com/insights/how-to-launch-a-product-in-canada/): A launch is not an announcement. A simple three-phase plan for launching a product in Canada that builds demand before launch day and keeps it going after.
- [A marketing audit checklist: 15 questions to ask about your own marketing](https://syedco.com/insights/marketing-audit-checklist/): Fifteen plain questions that show whether your marketing has a clear goal, a consistent message and numbers you can trust. Do it yourself in an afternoon.
- [Brand strategy vs brand identity: what’s the difference?](https://syedco.com/insights/brand-strategy-vs-brand-identity/): Brand strategy is the thinking, brand identity is how it looks. Why the order matters, and what each one includes before you hire a designer.
- [What affects the cost of a website (and how to budget for one)](https://syedco.com/insights/what-affects-the-cost-of-a-website/): The real factors behind website cost for organizations in Canada: scope, content, features, integrations and ongoing care, and how to budget sensibly.
- [What is a marketing campaign (and what isn’t)?](https://syedco.com/insights/what-is-a-marketing-campaign/): A marketing campaign is a coordinated plan where every tactic serves one goal and one message. Why that’s different from posting and running ads.
- [How to plan a brand video or photo shoot (and get content you can use)](https://syedco.com/insights/how-to-plan-a-brand-video-or-photo-shoot/): A practical guide to planning brand video and photography: start with the goal, build the shot list around it, prepare on the day and plan where it will live.
- [SEO vs AEO vs GEO: what’s the difference, and what should you actually do?](https://syedco.com/insights/seo-vs-aeo-vs-geo/): SEO, AEO and GEO explained in plain English, with what they have in common, where they differ and a short list of what to do first.
